beats.en: Packets of biscuits show the date of manufacture and the date of expiry. The manufacture date tells when it was made. The expiry date tells the last day we can safely eat it. After that day the food may spoil.

textbookBox.concept: Notice the day on which 15 July falls. Look at 15 August, 15 September and 15 October. The weekday moves ahead each month because months have 30 or 31 days, and 30 days is 4 weeks and 2 days.
